title: Enterprise Customer Profile Aggregation & Agentic AI Review

inspector.role: Collects live customer case signals across three internal operational platforms on demand instead of two daily batch runs.
inspector.dataBoundary: Internal corporate network only; read-only service credentials with audit logging.
inspector.tradeoff: API-first extraction preferred where exposed; deterministic RPA bridges legacy screens without APIs.
inspector.failureBehavior: Transient timeouts trigger bounded exponential retries in REFramework; hard failures surface partial-data flags to the operator.

inspector.role: Consolidates eight previously manual analytical SQL checks into parameterized structured queries.
inspector.dataBoundary: Warehouse VPC boundary; row-level scoped queries returning minimal attributes.
inspector.tradeoff: Pre-aggregated structured JSON lowers token load and prevents hallucinated calculations by the LLM.
inspector.failureBehavior: Warehouse latency spikes degrade gracefully to cached metadata with visible freshness timestamps.

inspector.role: Coordinates parallel data extraction, normalization, deterministic business rules, and agent invocation.
inspector.dataBoundary: Orchestrator encrypted queues; structured telemetry without raw PII in logs.
inspector.tradeoff: Using Maestro instead of a bespoke Python orchestrator preserved enterprise governance, RBAC, and existing operator support runbooks.
inspector.failureBehavior: Workflow exceptions isolate failed steps and route unverified cases straight to manual operator queues.

inspector.role: Strips or tokenizes regulated identifiers before LLM summarization and validates output schema before display.
inspector.dataBoundary: Strict enterprise PII perimeter — sensitive identifiers never leave approved boundaries.
inspector.tradeoff: Deterministic schema + redaction gate adds ~200ms overhead but guarantees auditable compliance.
inspector.failureBehavior: Schema violation or unmasked PII detection immediately blocks auto-summary and escalates to human-only review.

inspector.role: Synthesizes cross-platform customer signals into concise, structured risk & context briefs for operators.
inspector.dataBoundary: Private enterprise model endpoint; zero training retention on operational inputs.
inspector.tradeoff: Constrained prompt templates + factual grounding prioritized reliability over open-ended conversational freedom.
inspector.failureBehavior: Low-confidence or schema-mismatched responses are discarded and rerouted through the PII & Schema Gate.

inspector.role: Single unified operator workspace displaying live charts, structured tables, and grounded AI summaries for final human decisions.
inspector.dataBoundary: Role-based enterprise SSO; final decision authority remains 100% human-in-the-loop.
inspector.tradeoff: Unifying 3 tools + 8 scripts into one review screen drove the ~70% operator time reduction rather than raw LLM speed alone.
inspector.failureBehavior: If AI summary is withheld by guardrails, operators still see complete live charts and raw source tabs without workflow blockage.

nominal.label: Nominal Flow
nominal.description: Live multi-platform aggregation, sanitized LLM summarization, and unified human-in-the-loop approval (~70% faster review).

guardrail.label: Guardrail / PII Failure Mode
guardrail.description: When unmasked PII or an invalid output schema is detected, auto-summary is blocked and live source tables escalate directly to the operator.
